claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense mediation qualifier for through-item viewing
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing grant_sense atom can express Truesight, but the authored surface cannot constrain that sense to apply only while the bearer is peering through the specific gem.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem."
